name: Longleng–Tuensang National Highway
significance: NH 702B is a branch of NH 702. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Longleng to Tuensang, and it meets NH 702 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 702 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Changtongya to Jaboka
